description: This file contains test definitions for Sass mixins related to color modes, including dark mode handling via data-attributes and media queries. It uses testing-like constructs such as 'describe', 'it', 'assert', 'expect' to validate output of the 'color-mode' mixin under different configurations.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite describing behavior related to a specific feature or concept.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case within a test suite.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Begins an assertion block for testing output of mixins or functions.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Captures the generated output from the mixins for comparison.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Defines the expected output to be matched against actual output.

methods.name: color-mode
methods.description: A mixin that applies styles based on the specified color mode (e.g., dark) and output method.

methods.name: mix
methods.description: Function to interpolate or blend colors.
